ios.notes:
A fuller About this song, a solid top bar, and a mini player that lands cleanly.

Duotone for iPhone 7.3.3

New
- About this song now shows what the Windows app shows: the artist (photo, fans, a way to their page and the favourite star), how often you play them, their latest release, your most played of theirs, who fans also like, and the chorus.

Improved
- The bar at the top of Home, Liked Songs, Artists and Playlists is now solid when you scroll, instead of showing the list through it.
- Liquid Glass: the glass no longer looks grey and muddy, and Glass opacity now really goes from clear to dark.

Fixed
- Closing the player no longer makes the mini player artwork flash black after it lands.
- With Liquid Glass, the artwork's corners round off as it shrinks into the mini player. Without it, the mini player artwork has its almost square corners back.

Minimum version: 7.3.3

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v7.3.2...ios-v7.3.3

windows.notes:
Playlists open with the cover flying into place, every time.

Duotone for Windows 7.3.3

Fixed
- The first time you open a playlist after starting the app, its cover now flies into the page, as it does afterwards, instead of fading out and back in.

Minimum version: 7.3.3

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/win-v7.3.2...win-v7.3.3

windowsPreview.notes:
Duotone Preview 0.2.0

New
- Social redesigned: conversations without a frame, the friend you're listening with in a resizable panel on the right, the window takes their cover's colour, and messages, rows and panels animate in and out.
- The Preview now updates itself (installed copy only).

Improved
- Panels, dialogs, notices, menus and the selection bar slide in and out instead of popping.

Fixed
- Settings restored from your account after launch (3D cover, two-tone covers, layout, colour) now apply right away.
- The Preview no longer asks you to install the Duotone update.
- Friend lists could jump far off screen while reordering.
